gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-science-gothic: Shantell Sans draws with one fixed nib width and a wide, expressive mouth, like a lid cut from a tin. But Science Gothic, a sans-serif with uniform strokes, reads one letter at a time, stroke ends set far apart.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-syncopate: Loose and marker-drawn: Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width and a broad mouth on its curves. Syncopate, a sans with technical-pen steadiness and rope-ladder spacing, gives that looseness a rigid frame.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-manrope: Marker-loose Shantell Sans holds one nib width, with a broad mouth. Manrope, a sans with bright open curves and a minimal cap-to-lowercase step, reads smoothly down page after page.
gen-gf-sniglet-archivo: Quiet and level, Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back, with no accents of weight anywhere. Archivo, a sans with curves that open outward, reads with confident ease.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans has an uncommonly large x-height and uniform strokes, which sit comfortably beneath the level terminals of Sniglet. Neither one raises its voice, so the headline stays firm.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-orbit: Level and quiet, Sniglet ends its terminals short of curling back, with no accents of weight. But Orbit, a sans-serif with rope-like stems and characters floating apart, feels more detached beside it.
gen-gf-sniglet-manrope: Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back, keeping a quiet, level beat. What stands out is how Manrope, a sans-serif with bright open curve mouths, brightens that beat.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-bespoke-sans: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet with wide bridges between letters and lowercase built tall. Yet Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif with generous space where curves meet the stem, reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-abeezee: Stencil-cut and loud: Snowburst One bridges its letters widely, with an opening like a sprung paper clip. And ABeeZee, a sans-serif with neon-tube thickness and clear terminals, reads comfortably line after line.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari is a modern sans-serif with open letter mouths. Its tall middle zone sits well beneath Snowburst One, a stencil-cut display face with wide bridges between letters.
